_note: Photographs used on the site. Files are generated by scripts/prepare_images.py from originals in photos/. 'sizes' lists generated widths; 'width'/'height' are the largest file's dimensions (used for aspect ratio). Inline *asterisks* italicize species names. Locations are only given where known from the photo file names; add species and places when confirmed.
_credits_note: Captions show only Latin names. Photo credits are not shown under images; they are listed once in the Image credits section on the About page. Entries with credit_on_site=false (WETADAPT project photos) are not listed. Commons photos must stay listed with licence and source (licence requirement).
_video_note: Optional 'video' on 'hero': {"mp4": "/video/name.mp4", "webm": "/video/name.webm"}. Put files in static/video/. Keep it short, silent, under ~3 MB; the hero image is used as the poster and as the fallback for reduced motion.
